title: Is a Private Boat Trip in Madeira Worth the Money?
description: For a group of four or five, a private boat trip in Madeira costs 80 to 150 EUR each. For one person on a tight budget, a shared catamaran is better value.
heroAlt: Drone view of a white motor boat alone in turquoise water below the Fajã dos Padres cliffs

images.prompt: Drone photo from about 60 metres above the sea at Fajã dos Padres on Madeira's south coast, late morning in summer. A white 9 metre motor boat with grey cushioned seats and a dark canopy floats alone in deep turquoise and blue water close to the shore. Two small swimmers in the water beside it, seen from above, faces not visible. To one side, the strip of green terraced land at the foot of a sheer brown and green cliff. Far out on the open sea, a large white catamaran is a tiny shape. Realistic photo, true colours, sharp midday light.
images.alt: Drone view of a white motor boat alone in turquoise water below the Fajã dos Padres cliffs
